title.en: The Human Solutions Museum (人类解决问题的方法博物馆)

summary.en: A research question (which systems resisted a runaway dynamic, and what do they share?) and a product specification: inventions re-archived as dossiers from problem to borrowable method, indexed by problem structure. The only live mention lists it as a design programme, correspondence not established. Its separations and refusals have forms in the account, mostly in part and by other routes; its historical collection, index and social technologies do not. I looked for divergence and kept it: progress, 'solved', 'good tool' and tradition's efficacy.

name.en: Civilization as an accumulated stock of methods

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims 19, 27-28, 83

sense.en: Civilization is not a sequence of clever objects but an accumulated stock of methods by which people turned real problems into working mechanisms, tangible and intangible alike. Ordinary readers should learn that civilization did not happen naturally: it is generation after generation solving problems.

entries.quote: 文明不是自然发生的，而是一代代人解决问题的结果

reading.en: Nearest mechanism: a procedure or rule that later members rebuild, every change located at a gated step. That gives how something carried passes, in minimal models and instances, not a civilization's stock, nor that problem-solving produced it. The only live mention of the museum lists it among design programmes, correspondence not established. [AI reading]

says.en: Periphery theorem: in a declared construction, an exposure followed by faithful reconstruction passes on the procedure bit and network. 'one finite composition, not a population model or an origin of learning rules.'

Any process: a quantity is kept along every ungated course exactly when every ungated step keeps it; a change splits at a gated step. In one declared finite protocol, every rule change is located at an adoption step.

Root, a family of models: an entry rule on a shared stock, passed through members who also keep it, 'with no compliance and no records. It is not a definition of an institution.' That any actual institution meets the hypotheses is not shown.
'Applications elsewhere (design programmes, not results; correspondence not established)' names the human solutions museum among others.

account_adds.en: A rule can be kept and be the wrong rule [AI reading]. No law says cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.

source_adds.en: Civilization as the unit; methods as what accumulates; that what exists results from problem-solving; tangible and intangible creations on equal terms.

name.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical seven-stage shape

source.locator: The argument: The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical shape with separable stages: a real problem, a misreading of it, an insight redefining it, a mechanism on a named substrate, diffusion by a named force, what it solved, the new problems it made. Each stage does work no other does.

entries.quote: a civilizational advance has a canonical shape with seven stages

reading.en: The account has no sequence of stages for change or for an advance: its laws read courses under hypotheses, and the root lists 'inevitable improvement or universal growth' among what is not assumed. Single stages have neighbours (see the reframing, diffusion and new-problems entries); the shape does not. In the live text 'misread' names a misread case in T5, not a frame held of a problem. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The seven-stage shape itself, and that each stage can be interrogated separately across cases.

searched: stage, canonical, advance, progress, civilizational, misread, dossier in the overview, chapters, reviews and glossary
read: 07-SIGNIFICANCE T5's sentence on a misread or framed case

name.en: Real problems, solved by mechanisms

source.locator: Claims 28, 75; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: Problems are real and exist in a setting. A mechanism solves something, changing behaviours, relations, institutions, risks or capabilities. Inventions are not novelties from nowhere but mechanisms humans developed when facing real problems. The axis is problem to method.

entries.quote: 发明不是凭空出现的新奇物，而是人类面对真实问题时发展出的机制

reading.en: The account begins from relations with no solver presupposed. 'Solved' has the form of a standard met, read against something supplied, and meeting it says nothing of significance. So 'real problem' would have to say what reads it, for whom, among what it can tell apart. The source states this split nowhere; it is not refuted by the account. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Activity includes change and interaction without presupposing an agent, an intention or a purpose.'

Standard: 'what something is read against, so that it can be met or missed: a requirement on a level, an acceptable set of acts, a task.' 'That a standard is met says nothing of whether meeting it has significance.'

account_adds.en: The requirement and task a response answers to are listed as supplied, entering as hypotheses (07 §1).

source_adds.en: A claim about what humans in fact faced and did, which the account does not catalogue.

name.en: Moving civilization forward as the selection question

source.locator: Claims 18, 29-31; Relations (zhishan)

sense.en: An exhibit is selected not for novelty, being first or fame, but for moving humanistic civilization one step forward. Five criteria include expanding expression, choice, dignity, freedom, safety, cooperation or understanding. Ambivalent inventions may enter if both what they solved and what they made are shown.

entries.quote: 是否扩大了人的表达、选择、尊严、自由、安全、协作或理解能力

reading.en: The form is near C. The source says forward with no premise; here widening is better only under C for order, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. An ambivalent invention is a mixed comparison, which C does not decide. So the museum's order needs a further premise it does not name. Both refuse novelty as what is read. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The ethics adds two premises, neither asserted, warrant open': the continuation condition fixes scope; 'C: widening what can form is better.' 'C gives order; a ranking needs it or a premise in its place.'

One course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; 'a mixed comparison, a gain here and a loss there, is decided both ways by positive weightings.' Any type, finite listing, two-valued admission.

Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 life in the whole, 'not novelty or scale'; an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps is mixed with it and C does not rank them.

account_adds.en: Widening says which admits more, not which is better; it decides no mixed comparison, and weights that do are a further premise.

source_adds.en: A named list of goods and durable influence as admission criteria. The account names no such list and offers no test of whether a technology is good.

name.en: Every dossier shows the new problems: no sanctifying

source.locator: Claims 30, 38; Four refusals: Anti-sanctification; Relations (meta-attractor)

sense.en: Any advance may have side effects: misuse, controversy, new inequalities. The new-problems module is mandatory, because a borrower must know the cost. The museum must not sanctify inventions but show their complexity.

entries.quote: 本馆不应把发明神圣化，而要展示它们的复杂性

reading.en: Two parts. The refusal has the account's form: no law evaluates, and no type of closure is good or bad by its type. The cost has a checked form only where a rise is paid from beyond, under balance and a containing family that gains nothing; without that clause a rise need not reach beyond. The source's 'may' is thus given a place where it holds. [AI reading]

says.en: World, balance, the risen family within a containing family gaining nothing: 'the rise is paid from beyond in full.' 'Without the containing family's gaining nothing a rise need not reach beyond.'
'No law evaluates: none says a loss is a harm or restraint better.'
「一种闭是否支持、丰富或损害生生，由比较来说，不由类型来说」: scope by the continuation condition, order by C, both unasserted [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: Past the slack, a dependence breaks unseen by every selection rewarding the rise (05 §6). No loss is called a harm.

source_adds.en: The historical cost of actual inventions. The folder also reads this module as the meta-attractor's insight; the glossary's meta-attractor means closed capture only and 'never' the wider working sense.

name.en: The reframing thesis: insight over technology

source.locator: Claims 33-34, 44; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: What pushes civilization forward is usually not the technology but a new insight, of the kind that redefines the problem. Dossiers must show how a problem was misunderstood, moralized, suppressed or ignored, and why the old frame bounded the available solutions.

entries.quote: 真正推动文明前进的，往往不是技术本身，而是一个新的洞察

reading.en: A revision of a reading can open a correction no uniform policy had. But the gain comes from the reading, from executability or both: on Revising's process replenishing alone opens it with the reading unchanged, and rebuilding the link alone can fail without stock. There insight is neither necessary nor sufficient. The law gives no frequency, so 'usually' stays unread. A model's reading is not yet a society's frame. [AI reading]

says.en: Near-definitional, witnesses on Revising's process: a course opens a correction where no fitting uniform policy exists at x and one exists at x', 'the gain coming from the reading, from executability or both'; a coarser reading opens nothing.
Any process: every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, 'and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice.'

account_adds.en: With every act counted acceptable, any configuration with an executable act is correctable already, so an opening counts only with acceptability held fixed. Fixing what is acceptable is supplied.

source_adds.en: The historical thesis that insight usually leads; the typology of misreading (moralize, privatize, suppress, ignore, take as fate); redefinition as the kind of insight that counts.

name.en: A good idea is not an effective change: diffusion asked apart

source.locator: Claim 37; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A good idea is not an effective change. Diffusion must be asked separately: against what resistance, and through what force, whether the state, the market, grassroots transmission or a crisis.

entries.quote: 一个好想法不等于一个有效改变

reading.en: The same separation in other terms: discrimination, support and enactment come apart in Revising; reading, value and response are told apart. Spread has minimal models only: hearings with an adoption rule, and members who act on earlier acts and stop reading their coupling. None names a force of diffusion or measures resistance. The laws do not rest on the source. [AI reading]

says.en: 'in Revising, discrimination, support and enactment come apart (a correction the stock covers can be blocked by the link, one the link admits can lack stock).'

'Seeing is not valuing': enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. 'Coupling is not compliance': it bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: six conditions at once (coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure). 'Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient'; all six together still rank nothing.

Any type, near-definitional: where every member from k on acts alike whatever its coupling at the histories reached, selections through the acts are through the couplings before k. It does not show when an actual member stops reading its coupling.

account_adds.en: An imposed code makes all agree and each formation loses the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges (05 §9).

source_adds.en: The named forces of spread, resistance as an object of study, and the list of mechanism substrates (materials, institutions, law, movements, commerce).

name.en: Value without mechanism; tool without the problem

source.locator: Claims 21-22, 49; What is actually broken

sense.en: Two field failures. People put forward good value claims and design no mechanism that can land. People build tools without understanding the social problem they face. Movements offering only value and products optimizing only the product both fail.

entries.quote: 有些人提出了很好的价值主张，但没有设计出可以落地的机制

reading.en: The second has the form of the account's centre: a selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost. The first meets the account on its exposed side: its ethics is two premises, it says it shows no motivation or compliance, and its exits are 'none shown to hold of an actual collective'. The source's charge can be put to the account itself. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The account's centre [AI reading]: a selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts.'
The selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it; proved, near-definitional, its force the premise that a selector selects through just those.
Not shown: 'Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, or an unconditional or complete ranking of mixed comparisons'.
Achievable under stated conditions: 'Yes, for named exits', each under its hypotheses, none shown to hold of an actual collective.

account_adds.en: An exact reason a tool's success is silent on the setting: differences beyond a selector's couplings stay unselected, however hard it selects.

source_adds.en: The empirical diagnosis that movements and inventions fail this way, stated without data, and a mechanism that lands as the designer's task.

name.en: Problems of similar structure, linked and indexed

source.locator: Claims 23, 51, 56, 58-59; Why the index is the theory; Found by reading item 11

sense.en: People who think their problem new often face one of similar structure, met before at several levels. So organize by human problem and link exhibits by problem structure, with seven method relations as the vocabulary and typed, confidence-rated links, so a person can travel to structural ancestors. The README finds 'structure' never defined.

entries.quote: 这些推荐不是因为它们属于同一学科，而是因为它们处理了相似的问题结构

reading.en: Both refuse discipline or shared words as the link. In the account sameness of structure is stated: a lumping the step goes alike across; a law whose hypotheses a case is shown to meet; a correspondence classed and checked. That supplies, for laws and texts, what the README finds missing for problems. Nothing here says a present problem has an ancestor. [AI reading]

says.en: 相合: 「原文所说的结构，脊柱上有已检查之律与之结构相同。相合不是印证」; 定域 and 相分 defined beside it.

A law with content 'can become a science's law for a domain only once the domain is shown to meet its hypotheses', through a stated correspondence. 'The account states no science's law of its own yet.'
'Read as a correspondence, a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict'; read as a thesis, it forbids what the source fields leave open.
理: 'a lumping that models structure and change at once: one the step goes alike across'.

account_adds.en: Structural readings fail often: of 88 entries a reviser kept, a second checker corrected 84, and two reads are held unreliable (06 §7.1; the ratio not extended beyond them).

source_adds.en: An index of human problems, seven method relations, confidence on links, and the promise that a person's problem has a structural ancestor.

name.en: Reinvention as a retrieval failure of how history is stored

source.locator: What is actually broken; Claims 20, 24-25; Found by reading item 24

sense.en: Movements, products and inventions keep reinventing the wheel, not from laziness but because encyclopedias and museums store inventions as results, not as problem-solving. The corrective is an index change, intervening before action. The README adds that the mis-shaping may be incentivized.

entries.quote: it is a retrieval failure caused by an indexing decision

reading.en: No live text says how human experience is stored, retrieved or re-derived, or why. The nearest are other matters: a recorder of bounded size does not keep its whole history (02, with archives named among such recorders in one reading), and the account's verdict on itself that none of its central results is new mathematics. The repository's search-before-claiming duty is process, not live. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The diagnosis and its corrective entire.

searched: reinvent, wheel, retriev, by problem, problem-indexed, archiv across the overview, chapters, reviews, glossary and record pages
read: 02-MAP the merge laws and the reading 'Learners, archives and genomes are such recorders'

name.en: The eighth module: a method to borrow, adapt or avoid

source.locator: The eighth module is not history; Claims 39, 67, 69, 84

sense.en: The most important part of each exhibit is not history but a method a present actor can borrow, adapt or avoid, written as an action rule and not a slogan. What a user saves is the method, not the exhibit.

entries.quote: 用户可以收藏的不是展品，而是方法

reading.en: The closest form is the account's list of exits from locking loops: conditional moves, each with its edge. They come from models, not history, and hold only where hypotheses are met; the source's method travels by resemblance from a success. No live text addresses an actor's use of a historical case. [AI reading]

says.en: A table of exits, each law with model, hypotheses and edge (read what lies beyond the share; pool couplings; restraint within the joint slack and others). 'Every capture law here is a two-kind count model, its locks stated without noise.'

account_adds.en: Each exit states where it stops working, including when its window closes.

source_adds.en: Methods extracted from historical cases, written for an actor, and the toolbox that carries them.

name.en: The condom rule: tools for what regulation cannot enter

source.locator: Claims 45-47; The eighth module is not history

sense.en: If a problem occurs in highly private, shameful, dispersed, hard-to-regulate settings, the solution must be low-cost, private, autonomously usable, and must not require people first to change into their ideal selves. It comes from reading the condom as converting a bundle of problems into a portable tool.

entries.quote: 如果一个问题发生在高度私人、羞耻、分散、难以监管的场景里

reading.en: Proposed here; the account does not state it. A hard-to-regulate setting can be read as lying beyond what couples into a regulating selector, which cannot select on it. A tool used in the setting moves selection to one it does couple into. Cost, privacy and autonomy have no counterpart, and whether a case meets the premise is empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: The selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it; proved, near-definitional, its force the premise that a selector selects through just those.
A group's closure is the union of its members' closures; a pooled selection separates exactly what some member separates. 'Differences beyond the union stay unselected.'

source_adds.en: The design rule itself, drawn from one case, as the README's own critique of over-abstraction says; the bundle reading of the condom; shame and dispersal as conditions.

name.en: Good tools do not ask people to become nobler first

source.locator: Claim 48; The eighth module is not history; Found by reading item 15

sense.en: Good civilizational tools usually do not demand that people first become nobler; they offer a better option within real human nature, situations and limits. Design for the humans that exist. The README warns that, unamended, this licenses products that keep people where they are.

entries.quote: 好的文明工具，往往不是要求人先变得更高尚

reading.en: The account shares the refusal to presuppose compliance: its institution model has none. But 'good tool' and 'better option' are comparisons the source leaves ungrounded; here a ranking needs C or a premise in its place, the continuation condition fixing whose losses count, neither asserted. The README's worry is what the capture laws would frame: what a tool reads, and what it cannot. [AI reading]

says.en: 'C gives order; a ranking needs it or a premise in its place.' The continuation condition fixes scope; neither asserted, warrant open.
'Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them.'

Any type: from a locked configuration, each step adding at least one beyond, the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked. T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, and one case of it counts against it for trained judges.

account_adds.en: A ranking formed within the unfolding, acted on, selects, and read from the share it raises can lock (glossary).

source_adds.en: An anti-perfectionist stance about human nature and how to design for it; I found no live statement of it.

name.en: Personal failure that a public institution must carry

source.locator: Claim 35; The shape of a civilizational advance; Relations (relational-self-and-datong)

sense.en: One insight archetype: some problems treated as personal failure actually require a public institution to carry them (public health, libraries, accessible design). The 'individual defect' is rewritten as a problem of design or of the public system.

entries.quote: 某些被认为是个人失败的问题，其实需要公共制度来承接

reading.en: Part has a form: a loss can be made only together, the but-for holding for no single part, and each taker can stay within its count while the joint draw exceeds. So a loss need not be any one part's. That an institution must carry it does not follow: the pooled selection is conditional, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate. [AI reading]

says.en: Any process, withholding a supplied map: parts whose but-for statement holds together make the difference only together; it holds for no single one of them.
World, balance: formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. Restates the commons in near-definitional arithmetic, 'not who ought to take less'.

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C as widening for order, J1-J4): where one course's levels widen another's, something it admits lies beyond the acting group's closure and is selected through the pooled coupling of a group holding it.
'responsibility is not shown to differentiate'.

account_adds.en: A statement of which part made a difference, by a supplied withholding map, with no blame in it.

source_adds.en: Shame and moralization as what hides the structure; the institutional cases; carrying by a public institution as the answer. The account's institution model has no such role.

name.en: Exception-hunting: which systems solved it, multicellularity first

source.locator: Claims 2-3; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 1-2

sense.en: Some systems have solved the runaway dynamic, and the productive move is to find them: generalize the failure, enumerate the exceptions, extract what they share. The multicellular organism, which 'successfully eliminated this pattern', is the first named case; hunter-gatherer bands are among the later ones.

entries.quote: multicellular organism, if treated as a system, successfully eliminated this pattern, can you explain why and how

reading.en: The organism case has a checked form without the word: a rise confined to a whole ends with it, and founding from one part with sequestered founders lets selection among wholes decide. Known results restated. The method differs: exits here come from models, none shown of an actual collective, not from a collection of exceptions, and 'eliminated' is narrowed to stated clauses. [AI reading]

says.en: A confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within raised it to. Sequestered is 'a hypothesis stating an outcome, not a mechanism'. Restates known results on cancer and the germ line; that a tumour meets the clauses or a germ line is sequestered is empirical. Not shown: how parts first come to live as one; policing.
'No guarantee.' Exits from the loops that lock a collective, each holding under stated hypotheses; achievable 'for named exits', none shown to hold of an actual collective.

account_adds.en: A witness where a lineage depending on a condition outside the body outlasts it. Sequestration is not called better: ranking goes through C.

source_adds.en: A comparative collection of exceptions and what they share, the method's last two steps. Hunter-gatherer bands are not taken up.

name.en: Value systems as regulators; equality as stability

source.locator: Claim 4; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 3

sense.en: Historical societies held value systems that kept selfishness from compounding beyond regulatory control, which is why they lasted or held equilibrium. This, and not morality, is the root reason equality is needed.

entries.quote: This is the root cause we need equality

reading.en: A rule held by members can keep a shared level, inside a stated band, in one minimal model; it can also be the wrong rule and end the level. Why societies lasted is not addressed, and equality is not derived as a stability requirement: equal shares meet every need only where they meet the greatest. The rest is the source's assertion. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: 'neither the rule's being present nor its being held decides: a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule'. Not modelled: why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, records and purposes.
Any type, whole-number amounts: 'Equal shares meet every need exactly where they meet the greatest, giving more than the total need where needs differ'.
'no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. That is asked under the two premises of 07, the continuation condition for scope and C for order.'

account_adds.en: Positions sum to zero, so a rise needs a fall (05 §3): conflict stays real and no rule removes it.

source_adds.en: The historical explanation of longevity, value systems rather than entry rules as the regulator, and equality as a stability reason.

name.en: Traditions as social technology, with structural advantage

source.locator: Claims 6, 8; Terms: social technology; In Ren's own words 6, 8-9

sense.en: Confucianism is an excellent cognitive framework, a social technology, judged from cognitive and neural science, and classical Chinese narratives have clear structural, not merely moral, advantages against being consumed by Moloch. Are there others of that calibre? The README says the museum's own collection dropped this category.

entries.quote: 还有其他同样优秀的social technology吗

reading.en: 06 reads such texts passage by passage against the spine, 50 of them Confucian, as agreement, scope or divergence, and credits no tradition with an advantage or a calibre. Its gaps table reads 二柄 and 壹 as naming capture through the rule, not resistance to it. Structural agreement is no testimony to a tradition's efficacy; the source asserts what the account leaves unasserted. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The classical texts name the grammar's terms, not its operations; the readings are AI's'.
Assessment: 248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought, quoted verbatim and each classed 相合, 定域 or 相分; the classes and readings are AI's [AI reading, D54].
A gap named by passages and since proved: 经由规则的捕获, from 韩非“二柄”, 管子“据有余而制不足”, 商君书“壹”.

account_adds.en: Four non-relational layers recur in the texts, each answered inside the same tradition (06 §六).

source_adds.en: Tradition as engineered technology; a comparative judgement of calibre; a cognitive-science warrant; resistance to Moloch, a word the live account does not use.

name.en: A tradition's high point and degenerate mode coexist

source.locator: Claim 7; In Ren's own words 5; Genealogy 2026-03

sense.en: A high point and a degenerate mode of one tradition coexist: Confucian logic also became the value and pursuit of those who held or sought power, especially in prosperous periods. The README reads this as the anti-sanctification rule applied to a social technology.

entries.quote: 中国你说的高光时刻和退化模式是同时存在的

reading.en: A counter-rule read from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; the account reads the imperial examination so, designed to dilute hereditary capture, later a proxy trap. A tradition turning into what power's carriers value has that form if its reading comes from their share. The account says this of the examination only, as a reading, not of Confucian logic. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: 'a counter-rule whose rule came to be read from the share it selected', the imperial examination its example. An instance of the capture laws that adds no law; a counter-rule whose reading can favour the others need not lock.

Any type: with selection not lowering share and the rule read monotonically from it, the course locks. 'That actual rules read the share is the premise.' 'The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours'.

account_adds.en: What leaves the lock: a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection, or a reversal held past a threshold.

source_adds.en: The historical claim about Confucian logic and prosperity; coexistence of the high and degenerate, where the law gives a lock and not a coexistence.

name.en: Halakha and the 奏折 read as coordination engineering

source.locator: Claims 9, 12-13; In Ren's own words 10, 13-16 (endorsements, the README notes)

sense.en: Talmud/Halakha is possibly the most successful decentralized coordination system: dissent kept, micro-behaviour normed, no territory or army. The 奏折 is a formatted protocol: in a low-bandwidth, high-latency, zero-trust setting, minimal metadata plus structured language gave accurate, private, auditable two-way communication.

entries.quote: 在一个低带宽、高延迟、零信任的环境里

reading.en: Neither object nor mechanism appears. Nearby laws say how often one reader must read a condition and how fast a rule may change, and the imperial examination is one reading of capture. None concerns accurate, private or auditable report upward under adverse incentives, or law as coordination without force; 05 §12 models no records or sanctions. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Both readings of historical institutions as protocol engineering, and the governance question behind them: how a large polity gets accurate information upward.

name.en: Comparison across civilizations and scales; the narrow axis corrected

source.locator: Claims 10-11, 14-15; In Ren's own words 7, 11-12, 15

sense.en: Governance protocols are compared across civilizations and down the scale ladder to groups. Cultures must be read at collective cognitive dynamics, not customs, and living cases count. The Chinese and American axis is itself too narrow: other cultures must be read on the self-others and individualism-collectivism spectrum.

entries.quote: just realized i might be to bounded by chinese and american perspective

reading.en: The live account holds no such comparison: its classical chapter reads Chinese texts, its reviews Buddhist thought, philosophy, logic, alignment and the sciences. 'No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method' is another point. This crosswalk's domain list is aimed at the breadth, but stands in process, not live. Its group laws read partitions, not cultures. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The comparative programme, the reading level of collective cognitive dynamics, the search for living cases, and the self-correction on bias. The README says the museum specification itself dropped that correction.

name.en: No unreviewed content in the voice of a factual archive

source.locator: Four refusals: Anti-authority-laundering; Claims 86-90

sense.en: Content without sources, review and licensing is prototype copy and must not be published in the voice of a formal archive. The guard is machine-enforced: public mode against unready content fails the build, and public release needs two reliable sources and approved fact and sensitivity review.

entries.quote: 没有来源和审核的内容只能作为原型文案，不应以正式事实档案口吻公开

reading.en: Same concern, another mechanism. The account labels what each statement is and says on its first page who checked what. It does not withhold text no person has reviewed; it says so. The museum's rule would hold such text back. Its own reading adds that no check inside the work can show it serves its purpose. [AI reading]

says.en: 'the proofs are checked by machine, everything else only by AI review, and no person has yet reviewed it'.
'Every result statement in the chapters opens with one bold label, and a proved result names its base.' Theorem, conditional, assessment, reading and open are told apart.
Reading [AI reading, D66]: 'no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for'; only coupling in review by people widens what the work's selection reaches.

account_adds.en: Standings beyond true or false, and the rule that a frozen rule fixes the scoring, not that it measures what the thesis names.

source_adds.en: A publication state machine, a source table, sensitivity review, image licensing, and refusal to publish below a floor: a build that fails rather than a label that warns.

name.en: Against slogans and survivorship: conditions and failures on each method

source.locator: Claims 99-100; What was lost item 7; Found by reading items 13-14

sense.en: Methods must not become slogans: each reserves steps, antiPatterns, notApplicableWhen and failureSignals, and a core method should rest on exhibits from several domains. The concept wants failed mechanisms marked; the README warns that a method library with no failure record is a survivorship machine.

entries.quote: 它们是避免方法库口号化的长期接口

reading.en: The account's statements carry the same slots, and fills them: hypotheses, what is not shown, what would show it wrong, failed tests reported, premises shown holding in one model and failing in another. And a finite record does not certify renewal, on the renewable process, which is the survivorship point in one model. The museum's fields are all empty, by its README. [AI reading]

says.en: A column 'What would show it wrong'; T1 'passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings'.
What survives includes 'the premise ledger, with witnesses both ways and its calibrations', none of it a discovery.

The renewable process: for every horizon, two runs agree before it and then one renews and one consumes, so a reading fixed by h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one. 'The force lies in "every renewing run"'.

account_adds.en: T1, conjectured beyond its model: what persists through many renewal cycles has kept the joint draw within that condition's point of no return. Persistence certifies that much, not merit.

source_adds.en: A place for failed historical mechanisms and 'do not reuse', a wing for the unsolved, a rule of support across domains, and the collection-level selection bias.

name.en: Open with a threshold: nomination, curators, two sources

source.locator: Claims 79-81, 89; Found by reading item 16

sense.en: The museum is never finished and open to nomination, but openness is not no threshold: candidates answer the dossier's questions, curators review, discussion and revision go on; public release needs two reliable sources. It would be neither rigid authority nor arbitrary platform. The README finds who curates, appeal and withdrawal undefined.

entries.quote: 但开放不等于无门槛

reading.en: Counting two sources counts names. In the account reviewers count by independent causes: two moved under one cause fail while every name is kept. Readers drawn from the selected can lock a rule, and a pool recruiting only through itself reads a loss only if a reader comes from outside. These laws locate the README's gap on curators; they do not speak of museums. [AI reading]

says.en: Pure core, fault formulas and bounds supplied, faithful reviewers: 'Reviewers count by independent causes, not names'; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated induced envelope.
Any type: read the rule as the pool of its readers' readings; the rule read is then a monotone function of the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'.
'a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would ... unless a reader is admitted from outside' (witness).

account_adds.en: Independence of causes as the count, where the source counts sources by type.

source_adds.en: The governance loop of open nomination, public discussion, curatorial review and revision, and the honest refusal to simulate it in v0.1.

name.en: 活博物馆 as 生生 applied to knowledge

source.locator: Relations (becoming); Terms: living museum

sense.en: The folder relates itself to the account this way: the living museum is 生生 applied to knowledge, a system that goes on generating and is never finished, rather than a finished archive.

entries.quote: 活博物馆 is 生生 applied to knowledge

reading.en: The account's 生生 is life in the whole and its continuing generation, and 'nor any new organization': a growing knowledge system is not a case of it by name. The nearest live sentence, that an account of an unfolding that keeps generating is not finished by sealing it, uses a law by analogy only and says so. [AI reading]

says.en: 生生: 'life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1].' 'Neither the grammar's «生生» (renewal without end), nor 02's generation (生成) as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization.' T8 argues it under the continuation condition for scope and C for order.
'The work is not a flow, and the law is used here only by analogy: an account of an unfolding that keeps generating is not finished by sealing it.'

account_adds.en: Completion read three ways, one an exact statement of what cannot be shown.

source_adds.en: A knowledge institution's revisability as a way of being alive; a museum built against the museum as dead holding.
